findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 風險因素：2025 年數個全球與區域新進入者（含快速擴張的亞洲電商平台）以低價、廠商直送供應鏈與跨境物流在拉美取得顯著市占。
findings.excerpt: In 2025, several new global and regional entrants, including rapidly expanding Asian e-commerce platforms, gained significant market share in Latin America through low-price strategies, direct-from-manufacturer supply chains and cross-border logistics models.

findings.claim: 10-K：近年競爭加劇，本地業者成長與國際業者（主要在巴西與墨西哥）擴張。
findings.excerpt: Over the past few years, we have seen competition intensify not only as local players grow their e-commerce businesses, but also as international players expand, mainly in Brazil and Mexico.

findings.claim: 墨西哥反壟斷機關 2025 年 8 月結案，未施加矯正措施。
findings.excerpt: no corrective measures were imposed and the proceeding was closed.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋摘要（MoffettNathanson 2026-06 會議摘要、Seu Dinheiro、Fool）稱 Shopee 在巴西約 20% 份額；因無逐字原文未列入 findings，見 clues。

clues.claim: MoffettNathanson 2026 會議摘要：Shopee 在巴西快速取得約 20% 份額，Amazon 約 10% 持平。
